'''Twin Suns Mine''' was a mine in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Part of a [[Twin Suns mining compound|mining compound]], it was controlled by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang.<ref name="TOR:QQ" />
